channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Federal courts rebuke thousands of ICE detentions as habeas filings surge nationwide
item.description: Reuters review documents more than 4,400 unlawful custody rulings amid expanded immigration enforcement and rising court challenges.

item.title: After a hospital trip, ICE removed a 2-month-old from CoreCivic’s Dilley center
item.description: A Univision reporter located Juan Nicolás in Mexico after ICE removed the 2-month-old and his family from a CoreCivic-run Texas detention center, as lawmakers and advocates clash with DHS over medical care and oversight.

item.title: When does punishment fit the endless crimes of endless outlaws?
item.description: Few arrogant thugs resist the fates – / Comeuppance blights true reprobates.

item.title: Investigation into fetus found at South Carolina water plant draws new focus to post-Dobbs criminalization of pregnancy loss
item.description: Sumter County officials and SLED are seeking a DNA profile after workers found 13 to 15-week fetal remains at a wastewater facility, as advocates warn the probe and new bills could expand surveillance of miscarriage and abortion.
